title: RFK Files, UAP Records, and More
summary: New release spotted by the source watcher (https://www.archives.gov/news). Matched keywords: rfk. Awaiting editorial review — summary to be written from the primary source.
tldr: In April 2025 the National Archives released the first 10,000 pages of RFK assassination records, published its new UAP records collection under the 2024 NDAA, and the Nixon Library opened 25 boxes of newly declassified National Security Council records.
ai_summary:
AI review of the National Archives news article 'RFK Files, UAP Records, and More' (page last reviewed April 28, 2025), read in full:
- NARA released the first tranche of Records Related to the Assassination of Senator Robert F. Kennedy through a dedicated web page (Archives.gov/RFK); the first 10,000 pages 'fulfills part of President Trump's maximum transparency promise in Executive Order 14176.'
- On Thursday, April 24, NARA released Records Related to Unidentified Flying Objects and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena, fulfilling the 2024 National Defense Authorization Act requirement to establish the 'Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection.'
- On Wednesday, April 23, Acting Archivist Marco Rubio visited the National Archives at College Park — touring the Digitization Lab and receiving a briefing on digitization efforts related to EO 14176.
- The Richard Nixon Presidential Library released 25 boxes of newly declassified National Security Council records, covering the Strategic Arms Limitation Talks, negotiations to end the Vietnam War, diplomacy with the People's Republic of China, and more.
- Record summary was a placeholder ('Awaiting editorial review'); this is the editorial summary written from the primary source.
